subtopic: 05 · Trigonometric Identities and Compound Angle Formulas
title: Sum and difference formulas, with the sign mnemonic

board_content.text: Sign mnemonic: cosine flips the sign, sine follows the sign, tangent's denominator is opposite the numerator.

board_content.caption: cos(A−B): equal chords on the unit circle give the master formula

segments_english.text: Here's the first block of the catalogue, the sum and difference formulas.
For cosine of A plus or minus B: cosine A cosine B, then minus or plus sine A sine B. The sign is opposite to the one inside.
For sine of A plus or minus B: sine A cosine B, then plus or minus cosine A sine B. The sign matches the one inside.
For tangent of A plus or minus B: tangent A plus or minus tangent B, all over one minus or plus tangent A tangent B.
One clean mnemonic ties them: cosine flips the sign, sine follows the sign, and for tangent the denominator's sign is opposite the numerator's.

And this is where the master formula comes from, geometrically: two equal chords on the unit circle, one spanning A to B and one spanning A minus B back to the point one, zero. Equal central angles force equal chords, and equating their squared lengths gives cosine of A minus B.
Cosine of A plus B times cosine of A minus B equals cosine squared A minus sine squared B.
And sine of A plus B times sine of A minus B equals sine squared A minus sine squared B.

segments_hinglish.text: Catalogue का पहला block, sum और difference formulas.
Cosine of A plus or minus B के लिए: cosine A cosine B, फिर minus या plus sine A sine B. Sign अंदर वाले के opposite है.
Sine of A plus or minus B के लिए: sine A cosine B, फिर plus या minus cosine A sine B. Sign अंदर वाले से match करता है.
Tangent of A plus or minus B के लिए: tangent A plus or minus tangent B, पूरे over one minus या plus tangent A tangent B.
एक clean mnemonic इन्हें जोड़ता है: cosine sign flip करता है, sine sign follow करता है, और tangent में denominator का sign numerator के opposite होता है.

और master formula यहीं से आता है, geometrically: unit circle पर दो equal chords, एक A से B तक और एक A minus B से वापस point one, zero तक. Equal central angles equal chords force करते हैं, और उनकी squared lengths बराबर करने से मिलता है cosine of A minus B.
Cosine of A plus B times cosine of A minus B equals cosine squared A minus sine squared B.
और sine of A plus B times sine of A minus B equals sine squared A minus sine squared B.
